meta.label: Docker Cache Governor
meta.description: Inspect docker disk usage (system df / DockerRootDir vs DIP_HOME filesystem) and run gated prunes (builder prune with --keep-storage, image prune) with fixed argv — no shell, no --all, docker-group access only. daemon.json changes are only ever emitted as a manual sudo script.

params.name: operation
params.label: Operation
params.description: df, usage-scan, builder-prune, image-prune, or daemon-config-script.

params.name: keep_storage_gb
params.label: Builder keep-storage (GB)
params.description: builder-prune keeps this much build cache; also the cap in the emitted daemon.json script.

params.name: filter_until_hours
params.label: Image prune age filter (hours)
params.description: image-prune only removes dangling images older than this. 0 = no age filter.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run
params.description: docker prune has no native dry-run: when true, prune operations return the current df RECLAIMABLE estimate instead of executing.
